decisions.reason: Operator training is a low-cost complement to the established machine and service business that supports customer loyalty, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger problemistic search.
A fourth rotary axis is a natural accessory that extends the core milling systems and raises the value of each machine sold, so it fits the modular offer at little extra cost.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and its results are uncertain, but available slack and the firm's strategic direction toward future-oriented materials processing justify carrying it a while longer, though it is the most likely candidate for dropping.
The high-speed CNC milling line sits at the heart of the firm's established business and was presented on its own page, so it likely meets aspirations and is central to revenue.
An automatic tool change system builds on the established offer and improves the productivity of the core machines, making it a stable complement worth keeping.
